# Fixture — a normative label set stated inside an unmarked fence

The fence below states the option set to use. It is normative text, not a
demonstration, and nothing near it marks it as something to steer clear of.
Under a fence-alone carve-out it passed silently.

Use exactly these three options when confirming a dispatch:

```
[Dispatch now]
```

One conformant statement, so the scan is not empty:
`[Dispatch now - backend-architect]`, `[Hold - let me review the brief first]`
and `[Wrong agent - let me pick]`.
